{{Quote|I'm not buying, I'm selling. And the Seller's Motto is: "If you have to ask the price, you probably can't afford it."|Risha Drayen|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
